task.title: Force a Full Resync
task.shortdesc: Trigger a full resync to reprocess all content in the Heretto Deploy deployment, regardless of when each article was last modified.

context.p: A full resync walks the complete structure of your Heretto Deploy deployment and processes every article it finds. Unlike an incremental sync, a full resync does not use the high-water-mark cursor, so it does not advance the change cursor when it completes. The next scheduled or manual incremental sync will continue from the same cursor position as before the full resync.

ul.li: Articles exist in Heretto Deploy that were never captured by the change cursor, for example content published before sync tracking began.
You suspect the target system is missing articles or has content that is out of date.
You have made changes to the field mapping or data category mapping and want those changes applied to all articles, not just newly changed ones.

context.note: A full resync processes every article in your deployment and may take significantly longer than an incremental sync run, depending on the size of your content library.

step.cmd: In the navigation menu, click Syncs.
Click the name of the sync you want to resync.

step.info: A confirmation prompt may appear. Confirm that you want to proceed.
step.stepresult: A full resync run is queued. The run history table updates to show the new run with a status of Pending. Refresh the page to see the latest status as the run progresses.

result.p: When the run finishes, its status changes to Completed and the changed count reflects the total number of articles processed. The high-water-mark cursor is not updated; subsequent incremental runs will pick up changes from the same point as before the resync.
